understanding:
协同效应
一张卡牌的多段伤害（如连续拳）:会在全部段数结束后触发相同次数的柔韧的效果，也就是说下一段攻击不会被上一段攻击使目标获得的格挡所抵消掉。（可以简单理解为对目标造成了若干次无视格挡但可以触发柔韧的伤害）
受双发等效果影响而打出两次的卡牌：在第一张牌的效果结束后触发柔韧，第二张牌的伤害会被柔韧产生的格挡抵消一部分。

策略
多段伤害牌通常会使得目标一次性获得大量格挡，让本回合接下来的攻击变得困难，因此尽量将它们放在靠后的位置打出。
将伤害低的牌放在比较靠后的位置打出，让它们只削减格挡而不对本体造成伤害，从而使柔韧触发的次数尽可能少。

data.description_zh: 在你的下回合开始时，增加 X张 此牌的复制品到你的手牌中。

notes: P3 English source candidate; identity is source-backed and may await Chinese mapping.

data.description_en: Whenever you Scry, gain X Block.
data.description_zh: 你每次 预见 时，获得 X 点格挡 。

notes: P3 English source candidate; identity is source-backed and may await Chinese mapping.

data.description_en: You cannot gain Block from cards until the next X turns.

notes: P3 English source candidate; identity is source-backed and may await Chinese mapping.

data.description_en: You cannot draw cards this turn.
data.description_zh: 你在回合结束前都无法再抽牌。

notes: P3 English source candidate; identity is source-backed and may await Chinese mapping.

data.description_en: At the start of your turn, apply X Poison to ALL enemies.

notes: P3 English source candidate; identity is source-backed and may await Chinese mapping.

data.description_en: At the end of your turn, deal X damage to ALL enemies.

data.description_en: Whenever you receive attack damage from this enemy, add a Wound into your discard pile

notes: P3 English source candidate; identity is source-backed and may await Chinese mapping.

data.description_en: If you play X more card this turn, deal X damage to ALL enemies.

notes: P3 English source candidate; identity is source-backed and may await Chinese mapping.

data.description_en: Your next Attack deals double damage.

data.description_en: Deal Double Damage for the next #b turns.

data.description_en: At the end of your turn, gain X Block. Receiving unblocked attack damage reduces Plated Armor by 1.
data.description_zh: 在你的回合结束时获得 X 点 格挡 。受到攻击伤害而失去生命时， 多层护甲 的层数将会减少 1 。

notes: P3 English source candidate; identity is source-backed and may await Chinese mapping.

data.description_en: At the start of its turn, loses X HP, then reduce Poison by 1.

notes: P3 English source candidate; identity is source-backed and may await Chinese mapping.

data.description_en: Regen heals Hp at the end of your turn.Each turn,Regen is reduced by 1.
